name: ViolationList
intent: A selectable list of violations, used by any panel that offers a way into a ticket.
when: A panel lists violations that drill into their full ticket

commonMistakes.mistake: Re-implementing the row markup in each panel that lists violations
commonMistakes.fix: Use ViolationList so a camera's catch and a responder's queue cannot drift apart
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Copy the row markup between panels

lineage.confidence: unset — exercised through both panels in the browser
